name: Hekatonkheires
description: (Tag:summon)Dubbed "Magical Beast Transformation", Hekatonkheires is an ugly unlikeable dog-like Teigu that transforms into a larger form with great strength, blade-like teeth, and limb-regrowing regeneration unless its core breaks. Berserker mode further boosts it but leaves the Teigu unusable for a few days. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people; this overgrown rat has terrible taste. (A/N: Stylish modifications not included).
